title: GREATER IS HE
THAT IS IN YOU
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering

scenes.a: That subtle threat standing against you must yield.
Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
scenes.sub: YE ARE OF GOD LITTLE CHILDREN

scenes.a: Lord, when quiet intimidation tries to make us feel small, anchor our hearts in Your abiding presence.
You have claimed us as Your own and placed Your Spirit within us.
No scheme of opposition, no sudden fear, and no unseen danger can overpower the God who dwells in us.
Guard our steps, shield our minds from every lie of weakness, and give us courage to stand firm.
Amen. That subtle threat standing against you must yield.
